article: Foundations for Surreal and Surcomplex Mathematics
method: Public primary-source inspection via GitHub and official documentation; no local Lean execution.

verified_by_source_inspection: Surreal is an antisymmetrization of the numeric-game subtype.
The file defines the quotient interface, order, additive structure, and a choice-based representative.
A noncomputable Field Surreal instance is present.
Inverse correctness is established by a well-founded proof over numeric games.
SurrealHahnSeries is defined as a small-support Hahn subfield using order-dual exponents.
Field, LinearOrder, and IsStrictOrderedRing instances are present.
Its mk constructor requires Small.{u} support and reverse well-foundedness.
The pinned mathlib revision is dec5b2b780537b6eaf7f5e5f000c12f7387fb24d.

live_documentation.topic: Predicative universes, noncumulativity, universe polymorphism, and explicit lifting.
Formal summable families and hsum, distinguished from topological summability.
General real-closed-field interface; not a verification of a surreal instance.
Universe-indexed internal set construction and technical Definable API.

documentation_version_note: Live documentation was inspected on the stated date; it is not claimed to be a generated documentation build of the pinned mathlib revision.
not_verified_by_this_audit: Local compilation or kernel checking of the accompanying Lean files.
A complete normal-form ordered-field equivalence for the inspected game-based carrier.
A real-closed-field instance for that concrete carrier.
A Gonshor exponential or the analytic theories from the supplied manuscripts.
Absence of any of the above from other files, projects, or later revisions.
